- outer loop: `for k, var in variables.items():`
- inner loop: `for dim, size in zip(var.dims, var.shape, strict=True):`

So the total number of inner-loop iterations is the sum, over all six variables, of `len(var.dims)`; equivalently the number of dimensions of each variable, since `zip(var.dims, var.shape)` pairs one dim with one shape entry.
